brief.offer: Migration help for newsletter writers moving from Substack

facts.claim: Buttondown is a newsletter platform for starting, growing, and monetizing newsletters, with subscriber management, email composition, paid subscriptions, and automations.
facts.excerpt: Buttondown is a newsletter platform that makes it easy to start, grow, and monetize your newsletter. It offers subscriber management, email composition, paid subscriptions, automations, and a comprehensive API.

facts.claim: The platform supports Stripe paid subscriptions, webhooks, and integrations including Zapier, Discord, and RSS feeds.
facts.excerpt: It supports Markdown and rich text editing, custom domains, paid subscriptions via Stripe, automations, webhooks, and deep integrations with tools like Zapier, Discord, and RSS feeds.

facts.claim: Buttondown offers a feature-complete API for building tools and managing newsletter operations.
facts.excerpt: And if you want to try your hand at building your own tools, our API is feature-complete & beloved in the industry.
facts.source_title: Buttondown — Newsletter software for people like you

facts.claim: Buttondown offers one-click concierge migration for newsletter lists of any size, with migration within one business day.
facts.excerpt: That’s why we offerone-click concierge migration for your whole list, no matter how large it may be. Just create your account for free, contact us, and we’ll get you migrated within one business day.
facts.source_title: Buttondown — Newsletter software for people like you

facts.claim: Buttondown says it does not take fees from customers’ paid subscribers.
facts.excerpt: We use Buttondown for our own mailing lists. And we don’t take fees from yourpaid subscribers.
facts.source_title: Buttondown — Newsletter software for people like you

facts.claim: Buttondown says customer feedback determines its product roadmap.
facts.excerpt: We prioritize our product roadmap from our customer feedback, not our own agenda.
facts.source_title: Buttondown — Newsletter software for people like you

facts.claim: Buttondown built a new customer home screen to ask onboarding questions and help users understand the health and progress of their lists.
facts.excerpt: Doing so gives us a place to ask these questions and get people acclimated to the product, and it also helps existing customers better understand the health & progress of their lists at a glance.
facts.source_title: How we welcome new customers at Buttondown

facts.claim: Buttondown promotes its deliverability, spam protection, personalization, automations, and analytics as business-focused capabilities.
facts.excerpt: Fortunately, Buttondown’s deliverability is among the highest in the industry, and our spam protection is best-in-class. Our robust personalization &automation  features allow your email to work for you. Our analytics show you what’s working and how.
facts.source_title: Buttondown — Newsletter software for people like you

research.website_note: The given domain hosts Buttondown’s official product pages and describes its newsletter platform.

strategy.observation: Buttondown already offers one-click concierge migration for newsletter lists of any size, with migration within one business day.
strategy.offer_link: Because Buttondown already provides this service, outside Substack-migration help would matter only if the team wanted extra capacity or a different kind of migration support.
hypotheses: Buttondown may sometimes want extra capacity for migration requests, but the facts do not indicate that it does.
strategy.angle: Buttondown already offers one-click concierge migrations within one business day, so external Substack-migration help would only be relevant if you wanted extra capacity or coverage.
strategy.fit_reason: The offer overlaps directly with a migration service Buttondown already provides; extra capacity is a possible use, but there is no evidence the team needs it.
